name: Admin Standalone Email Defaults Config
description: Admin configures the standalone email composer defaults from the 'Valores por defecto' tab of /panel/emails (deep-linkable via ?tab=defaults): default greeting (with {client_name}/{title} variables), default footer and default signer. Saved via PUT /api/emails/defaults/ into EmailTemplateConfig('branded_email').content_overrides; 'Restaurar valores originales' submits registry/settings defaults which clears the overrides. The configured signer is used for standalone sends and previews (proposal emails keep their per-proposal signer).
knownGaps: Spec does not exercise Branch A ("Restaurar valores originales") nor Branch B (invalid signer 400) (2026-07-16 audit).
